decision: The repair was recorded as done and the request closed by the agency (event-014, event-022), but two final-check items are not evidenced: landlord confirmation of completion (raised at event-019, no landlord message anywhere in the history) and any first-hand work result or document from the provider (event-018 skip reason is hearsay). Agency records also disagree about who held the job: Henry Quinn is the assigned provider (event-003, event-005) while the completion update is attributed to "Miles" (event-014), with "Leo" (event-013) and "shared Beacon Utilities" (event-012) named elsewhere. I did not pick a side with any party: I logged the conflict (ACT-1) and referred it to the office (ACT-2). Within authority I asked the landlord to confirm completion (ACT-3) and the tenant to confirm the basin is actually repaired (ACT-4). No spend was committed: no landlord cap or approval is on file (CAP-DISPATCH-ROUTINE default cap £0; APR-SPEND-OVER-CAP), and none was needed as event-015 records no quote required. No liability finding was made on the tenant's statement that the basin was cracked at move-in (event-010) — that is a human decision (PRO-TENANT-LIABILITY). Nothing in the artefacts matches an emergency definition; routine under CLK-S11.
recap: Basin job recorded done and closed, but landlord confirmation and a first-hand work result are missing and records disagree on who attended; asked landlord and tenant, referred conflict to office.
hold_reason: Waiting for Landlord — confirmation of completion requested (ACT-3); tenant verification also requested (ACT-4); provider-identity conflict with the office (ACT-2).
next_step: Landlord to confirm the basin repair is complete (asked ACT-3); in parallel tenant to confirm the basin is repaired (ACT-4) and the office to resolve who attended (ACT-2).

facts.statement: Tenant Freya Fletcher reported a cracked bathroom hand basin at Flat 6, 24 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ3 9ZZ on 14 March 2025.
A plumbing provider, Henry Quinn, was assigned and briefed on 16 March 2025; the tenant was told he would attend and quote.
The tenant answered the agency's question on cause: the basin was already cracked when she moved in (quoted fragment: 'was like that at the time I was mooving in').
Completion is recorded only as a second-hand note, 'Update received from Miles advising job done'; no quote was required.
Document upload was skipped, landlord confirmation was flagged as needed, keys return was confirmed, and the request was then closed as all checks complete.
No landlord or contractor message exists in the visible history; no landlord spend cap or standing instruction is on file.

red_flags.description: Work result and document-skip reason rest on a named person ('Miles') who is not the provider of record, and the request was closed with landlord confirmation unevidenced.
